_comment: THE ONE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the owner's other projects.
Three things read this file: the Projects section on site/index.html, the
demo catalogue in site/static/demo-api.js, and scripts/seed-projects.py,
which writes them into the real links catalogue when a cluster is up.
url: null means NOT YET SUPPLIED. Every consumer skips those entries, and
the seeder names them rather than skipping in silence.
public DECIDES WHERE AN ENTRY IS ALLOWED TO APPEAR, and it is the field
that matters most here.
public: true   goes everywhere -- the portfolio page, the demo
catalogue, and the real catalogue.
public: false  ONLY the real catalogue, which is the owner's private
start page.
Two of these are localhost and one is behind a personal Xiaomi account.
Those are entirely CORRECT links for a private start page -- pointing at
your own dev server is what a start page is for -- and entirely WRONG on a
public portfolio page, where every visitor gets a connection error and
reads it as carelessness.
So the flag is not a quality judgement. It is the difference between 'a
link that works for me' and 'a link that works for anyone'.
Blurbs are quoted or condensed from each project's own README rather than
invented, so they stay true if someone follows the source link.

projects.name: gymlog
projects.blurb: Single-user installable PWA for logging resistance training and daily food intake — and for seeing whether any of it is working.

projects.name: Procedo Infosystems
projects.blurb: Marketing site for an infrastructure-first IT firm — IT infrastructure, security, audio-visual, telecom and power systems.
projects.note: No URL yet, but it is READY to deploy: static Astro build, netlify.toml already committed, default branch master. Likely belongs on the client's own domain rather than a netlify.app subdomain.

projects.name: Acharya Amit Puri
projects.blurb: Practice site for a Vastu, Vedic astrology and numerology consultant. Near-zero JavaScript, edited from a single config file.
projects.note: Repo is acharya-amit-puri, not -pur; the shorter name only works because GitHub redirects. Local dev server on 4322 rather than Astro's default 4321, so it can run beside Procedo. Also deploy-ready: netlify.toml committed, default branch main. Flip public to true once it has a real URL.

projects.name: Notes
projects.note: Returns 200 to anyone, but it is the owner's personal account -- a visitor gets a login screen, not the notes. Never public.

projects.name: app-hub
projects.blurb: This project's own dashboard, running locally.
projects.note: gateway running locally. In-cluster the equivalent is the ALB from E-06, whose hostname changes on every rebuild and so cannot be written down here. Deliberately not public: the public equivalent is the demo on this same site.
